messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — canary rollback didn't trigger reliably and the blast radius ended up larger than expected. We need concrete remediation owners, short timelines, and a ticket to track recurring patterns.

eli: +1. Repro shows rollback hook failed when the feature-flag service returned intermittent 504s. Root cause is twofold: network retries in the controller and no local fallback decision. Suggest adding a local fallback policy so the canary controller can decide if it should treat missing flag data as 'disable'.

samira: I can own the fallback + alerting side. Proposal: if flag service times out > 2s for >3 requests in a minute, treat that as a hard 'disable' and trigger rollback. I'll write an RFC and implement alert rules. ETA: dry-run in staging within 3 days. @eli can you spec the controller changes?

eli: Yep — I'll open a PR for the rollback controller logic + unit tests and add a circuit-breaker around flag lookups. Also instrument metrics for flag timeouts. Target: PR by EOD Wed.

aisha: We should also add blast-radius controls to the rollout API — e.g., 'max_users', 'max_routes', and per-customer opt-out labels. I'll own the rollout config changes and schema migration. ETA: 2 weeks for full rollout + migration plan.

nathan: From product: we want an easy way to pin SLO-critical customers to stable. Can we add a 'slo_exempt' customer label that the controller respects (always route to stable)? @aisha

aisha: Yes — adding a 'slo_exempt' label to customer metadata. I'll include that in the schema change and docs.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-controller v0.9.1 -> staging

samira: :thumbsup: I'll add an alert: if errors increase >5% (relative) in 5m during a canary, trigger a rollback workflow and page oncall. Will run a dry-run in staging with synthetic traffic to validate thresholds.

ops_oncall: Oncall here — will validate alert thresholds and run the dry-run during the next maintenance window. When do we expect the PRs to land?

eli: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/canary-controller/pull/1234 — includes local fallback, circuit-breaker, and new metrics. Needs review from @aisha and @samira.

aisha: Reviewing now. Noted a nit on config schema; will leave an inline comment.

nathan: Request: can we add a single dashboard tile showing canary health + rollback status (green/yellow/red) so SRE/Product/DevEx can embed in runbooks?

mira: Good idea. @devex-team can you prototype a 1-tile widget? Low priority for this sprint but we should have a mock in the next incident runbook.

devex-team: We'll prototype a widget this week and share a mock by Fri.

samira: Action recap (I'll create the tracking ticket and link to postmortem):
- samira: alert rule + dry-run in staging (3 days)
- eli: rollback controller PR + unit tests (PR up, review requested)
- aisha: blast-radius config + schema migration (2 weeks)
- devex-team: dashboard widget mock (5 days)
- mira: update postmortem with owners + timelines

mira: Thanks all. Please add assignees and target dates in the ticket. I'll ping in 48h for status updates.
